description: Servers, vCPU, RAM and disks for a Directum RX installation by role (application servers, RabbitMQ, DBMS, document storage, full-text search, Ario, Kubernetes, monitoring, backups) for production, test and pre-production. Runs the very model of the drxinfra.ru/sizing.html calculator, so the numbers are the same as on the page, and returns a link that opens this calculation there. An estimate for budget and requirements, not a load test. Every parameter is optional; omitted ones take the page defaults.

active.description: Users working at the same time; 0 means 30% of the total

arioPages.description: Ario flow, pages per hour (only with ario)

db.description: pg = PostgreSQL, mssql = Microsoft SQL Server

ha.description: High availability: every layer survives the loss of one node

historyGB.description: Archive migrated from the old system, GB: counts for storage, not for load

k8s.description: ns = a namespace in an existing cluster, full = the whole cluster (only with place=k8s)

os.description: linux, or windows (Windows Server: RX as services, no containers)

pgKind.description: pro = Postgres Pro, vanilla = PostgreSQL (only with db=pg)

place.description: vm = containers on virtual machines, k8s = Kubernetes (Linux only)

preprodLikeProd.description: Pre-production with the same high availability as production

store.description: s3 = object storage (MinIO or S3 storage), fs = file storage (volume, NFS, SMB)

test.description: Test contour (a fifth of users, a tenth of data)

testInCluster.description: Test and pre-production in the same cluster (with place=k8s and k8s=full)

name: size_rx
title: Directum RX sizing
